patch_description:
Remove the duplicated XX/YY/ZZ entangling block and replace it with a single-parameter set of long-range CRZ gates on maximal-distance diagonal pairs. 

Rationale:
- Current program has doubled entangling gates (XX/YY/ZZ appear twice) increasing depth to 22, yet scores worse than simpler prior
- Best prior (score 0.58) had simpler structure with single entangling layer and only 8 distinct parameters
- Worst-group margin (0.32) indicates poor separation on hard samples - need better global coherence
- Long-range CRZ on diagonal pairs [0,5], [1,6], [2,7], [3,4] creates maximal-distance correlations with ONE shared parameter
- This maintains parameter efficiency while targeting the robust separation metric (worst_group_margin)
- Expected improvements: reduced depth, better generalization via parameter economy, improved hard-sample separation through global phase coupling
